spans.s:
ITA-3.10.1.18 nakhaḥ, karajaḥ नखः, करजः
Nail

ITA-1.11.3 karaṇam करणम्
Tool, instrument
The tool or instrument used for treatment, i.e. a medicine or procedure.

ITA-3.9.18 karaṇam करणम्
Sensory, motor and intellectual faculties
Altogether there are thirteen of these faculties.

ITA-1.8.2.29 kāraṇam कारणम्
Causative agent
The agent which initiates action independently; also denoted as cause (hetu) or doer (karma). It may be of three types: inherent cause (samavayikarana), non-inherent cause (asamavayi-karaṇa) and efficient cause (nimitta-karana).

ITA-1.11.2 kāraṇam कारणम्
Principal agent
The means by which an action is effectuated, the idea expressed by instrumental cause: in the medical context may often refer to the physician, who is instrumental in maintaining fundamental bodily equilibrium.

ITA-9.6.44 karapatraśastram करपत्रशस्त्रम्
Bone saw
A type of saw-like instrument used to cut bone.

ITA-5.63.21 karālaḥ करालः
Improper eruption of teeth, irregular teeth
A disorder characterized by improperly erupted teeth; eruption of teeth with disagreeable appearance.

ITA-5.64.15 karṇa-arbudaḥ कर्ण-अर्बुदः
Tumours of ear

ITA-5.64.16 karṇa-arśaḥ कर्ण-अर्शः
Auricular polyp

ITA-5.64.7 karṇa-kaṇḍūḥ कर्ण-कण्डूः
Auricular pruritis
A disorder characterized by severe itching sensation in the ear canal

ITA-5.64.5 karṇa-kṣveḍaḥ कर्ण-क्ष्वेडः
Abnormal perception of sounds, tinnitus due to excess excertion, depletion of structural components.
A disorder characterized by hearing whistling or high-pitched sounds; hearing a flute-like sound.

ITA-5.64.8 karṇa-gūthakaḥ कर्ण-गूथकः
Impacted wax
A disorder characterized by the presence of dried śleṣma in the ear.

ITA-5.64.3 karṇa-nādaḥ कर्ण-नादः
Abnormal perception of sounds, tinnitus due to mechanical reasons
A disorder characterized by hearing various kinds of sound in the ear, e.g. bugle, drum or mṛdaṅga, conch.

ITA-5.64.12 karṇa-pākaḥ कर्ण-पाकः
Otitis externa
A disorder characterized by putrefaction inside ear/ suppuration; manifestation of moistness inside ear.

ITA-5.64.9 karṇa-pratināhaḥ कर्ण-प्रतिनाहः
Tympanic perforation
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: liquified wax emerging through the nose; hemicranial pain; earache; heaviness in ear; feeling of obstruction in ear; coating of liquified earwax inside ear; causing varying kinds of head disease.

ITA-5.64.11 karṇa-vidradhiḥ कर्ण-विद्रधिः
Ear abscess

ITA-5.64.14 karṇa-śophaḥ/ karṇaśothaḥ कर्ण-शोफः/कर्णशोथः
Oedema of ear
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: abnormal hearing; itching; fixed swelling; whitish discharge; unctuous discharge; mild pain; heaviness of head; heaviness in neck region; heaviness over mandibular region; mild pain; itching inside ear; swelling around ear; preference for hot things; discharge of thick white fluid as in perichondritis if suppuration occurs.

ITA-5.64.6 karṇa-srāvaḥ कर्ण-स्रावः
Otorrhoea
A disorder characterized by pus discharge from the ears.

ITA-9.5.60 karṇadhūpanam कर्णधूपनम्
Medicated fumigation of ear
The procedure of fumigation therapy in ear diseases.
ITA-

.5 karṇanāḍī कर्णनाडी
External auditory canal

ITA-5.64.21 karṇapālirogaḥ कर्णपालिरोगः
Disorders of ear lobule

ITA-9.5.41 karṇapālī-abhivardhanaabhyaṅgaḥ कर्णपाली-अभिवर्धनअभ्यङ्गः
Massage for elongation of ear lobule
A post-lobuloplasty procedure for strengthening and elongating the earlobe.
ITA-

.6 karṇapīṭham कर्णपीठम्
Base of the ear, pinna
ITA-

.8 karṇaputrakaḥ कर्णपुत्रकः
External ear, tragus

ITA-9.5.58 karṇapūraṇam कर्णपूरणम्
Retention of medications in ear canal
The procedure of instilling lukewarm oils or herbal juices into the ear and retaining them for a specific time.
ITA-

.9 karṇapṛṣṭham कर्णपृष्ठम्
Mastoid region

ITA-9.5.61 karṇaprakṣālanam कर्णप्रक्षालनम्
Ear canal wash
The procedure of cleaning the ear canal using a medicated liquid.

ITA-9.5.62 karṇapramārjanam कर्णप्रमार्जनम्
Ear canal cleaning
The procedure of cleaning the ear canal.
ITA-

karṇamalaḥ कर्णमलः
Ear wax
ITA-

.4 karṇamūlam कर्णमूलम्
Parotid region

ITA-5.64.1 karṇarogaḥ कर्णरोगः
Disorders of ear

ITA-9.5.40 karṇarogacikitsā कर्णरोगचिकित्सा
Management of diseases of the ear
Treatment of diseases related to the ear.
ITA-

.7 karṇapālī, karṇalatikā कर्णपाली, कर्णलतिका
Lobe of the ear

ITA-9.4.32 karṇavedhanasaṁskāraḥ कर्णवेधनसंस्कारः
Ear-piercing ceremony
A ceremony performed during the period of infancy (6 to 8 months) in which the earlobes are pierced.

ITA-5.76.202 karṇavyadhajanyarogaḥ कर्णव्यधजन्यरोगः
Condition due to improper piercing of ear lobule or pinna

ITA-5.76.206 karṇavyadhanasandhānaayogaḥ कर्णव्यधनसन्धान-अयोगः
Condition of improper repair of punctured ear
ITA-

.10 karṇaśaṣkulikā कर्णशष्कुलिका
External ear

ITA-5.64.2 karṇaśūlaḥ कर्णशूलः
Ear pain; otalgia
ITA-

.12 karṇa-srotaḥ कर्णस्रोतः
External auditory meatus

ITA-9.5.59 Karṇasvedanam कर्णस्वेदनम्
Sudation therapy of ear
The procedure of achieve sudation therapy of the ear by nāḍīsveda (applying a jet of steam through a tube) and piṇḍāsveda (applying a poultice).
ITA-

.11 karṇāvaṭuḥ कर्णावटुः
Concha of the ear

ITA-3.13.11 karṇāsthi कर्णास्थि
Bones of the ear

ITA-1.9.3.2.5 kartā कर्ता
The doer, the executing agent
A word which also denotes soul, but may be used figuratively to denote author or physician.
ITA-

karparapācanam कर्परपाचनम्
Cooking on pan
The method of cooking on a hot pan which is usually made of clay.

ITA-1.9.5.1 karma कर्म
Action
Activity, one of the six ontological categories of an object. It refers to pharmacological, nutritional and action in the context of medical practice.
ITA-

.1 karma कर्म
Pharmacological activity
Defined as the action inherent in the substance. Covers a wide range of pharmaco-therapeutic actions and nutritional effects.

ITA-1.9.2.4 karma-viśeṣaḥ कर्म-विशेषः
Dissimilarity at the level of action
An activity which causes depletion or reduction, e.g. physical exercise reducing kapha, which otherwise would increase with inactivity.

ITA-1.9.1.4 karma-sāmānyam कर्म-सामान्यम्
Similarity at the level of action
Action or physical movement which may lead to an increase in a specific element. e.g. sleep increasing kapha.

ITA-9.2.82 karmabastiḥ कर्मबस्तिः
Course of thirty combined therapeutic enemas
A type of therapeutic enema based on a course of thirty enemas which includes eighteen half-dose therapeutic ghee or oily enemas and twelve therapeutic decoction enemas, , administered in a particular sequence.

ITA-5.76.28 karmabhārādhvahtopavāsamaithunādhyayanavyāyāmacintāprasakta कर्मभाराध्वह्तोपवासमैथुना ध्ययनव्यायामचिन्ताप्रसक्त
Condition caused by emetic therapy administered to person indulging in excessive physical activity, fasting, sex, loud reading of books and excessive thinking
A condition characterized by fear of aggravation of vata; haemorrhage or injury to lungs; haemorrhage or injury to lungs.

ITA-3.10.2 karmendriyam कर्मेन्द्रियम्
Motor faculty
The five faculties of action: speech faculty (vak), hands (pani),,legs (padaḥ), anus (payu) and genitalia (upastha).
ITA-

.17 karśanam कर्शनम्
Weight-reducing
A related term to emaciating substance.
ITA-

.7 karṣaḥ, tolā कर्षः, तोला
Measure of weight approximately equal to 12 g
Measure of weight equal to 12 masha.

ITA-9.2.47 karṣūsvedaḥ कर्षूस्वेदः
Sweating induced in a pit filled with embers
A type of sudation therapy in which diaphoresis is achieved by lying down on or sitting over a bed placed above a pit filled with the embers of prescribed substances.
ITA-

kāram कारम्
Water derived from hailstones
Water obtained by melting hailstones

ITA-1.9.3.1.1 kāraṇadravyam कारणद्रव्यम्
Causal material
A group of nine elementary causal substances that underlie the manifestation of all other substances, namely five basic elements (space, air, fire, water and earth), self (atma), mind (manas), time (kala) and direction (dik).
ITA-

kārmuka-bījam कार्मुकबीजम्
Healthy sperm, ovum
Normal, healthy and potential sperm or ovum.

ITA-9.9.8 kārmukabījaḥ कार्मुकबीजः
Healthy sperm
Normal, healthy and effective spermatocytes.

ITA-1.11.5 kāryaḥ कार्यः
Treatment protocol
The process undertaken to attain health or the fundamental bodily equilibrium (dhatusamya), i.e. the treatment process.

ITA-1.9.3.7.1 kāryadravyam कार्यद्रव्यम्
An applicable or effective substance that is a manifestation of the nine causal substances.

ITA-1.11.6 kāryaphalam कार्यफलम्
Immediate outcome, primary endpoint
The aim of treatment: to bring mind, intellect, the sense organs and the body into equilibrium and attain a state of healthiness or happiness.

ITA-1.11.4 kāryayoniḥ कार्ययोनिः
Substratum of treatment
The intimate cause of illness, i.e. a disturbance of the fundamental bodily equilibrium.
